status.401: Authentication is not configured for the instance. Add an Authorization or X-API-Key header in Instance Management.
status.403: Insufficient permissions. Check the instance's access permission configuration.
status.404: Endpoint not found. Check whether the instance URL and port are correct.
status.429: Request rate limit exceeded. Retry later or adjust the rate limit configuration.
status.500: Internal server error. Check the instance logs to troubleshoot.
status.502: Instance unreachable. Check whether the instance is running properly.
status.503: Service unavailable. The instance may be restarting or the circuit breaker may have tripped.
status.504: Request timed out. Check the instance performance or adjust the timeout configuration.

keyword.connectionRefused: Unable to connect to the instance. Check whether the instance is started.
keyword.timeout: Request timed out; the instance is responding too slowly.
keyword.unknownModel: Model not found. Check whether the model name is correct.
keyword.notFound: Resource not found. Check the configuration.
keyword.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check the instance's authentication configuration.
keyword.invalidApiKey: Invalid API Key. Check the instance's authentication credentials.
keyword.notSupported: Parameter not supported. Check the request parameters.
keyword.serviceDegraded: The service is circuit-broken. Retry later or reset the circuit breaker.
